title: No events.json files remain tracked in git
detail: Must return 0 after ticket 580019e8 lands. Currently ~76 tracked files totalling ~99MB. Run the .gitignore side first (vt-session-gitignore-policy already covers the pattern rules via cargo test -p session-api --test gitignore_policy) or the files will be re-added on the next commit. History rewrite is explicitly out of scope: git rm --cached only.
